prepare: git -C <absolute clone path> fetch --no-tags "https://github.com/$DSH_SUPERAGENT_GITHUB_REPOSITORY.git" "${DSH_SUPERAGENT_GITHUB_PR_HEAD:-HEAD}:refs/dsh-superagent/$DSH_SUPERAGENT_TICKET" && git -C <absolute clone path> worktree add -b "agent/$DSH_SUPERAGENT_NAME" "$DSH_SUPERAGENT_DIR" "refs/dsh-superagent/$DSH_SUPERAGENT_TICKET" && cd "$DSH_SUPERAGENT_DIR" && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q -e '.[dev,agent]'
